_comment: Template for cluster/opportunistic_scheduler.py --scope. Copy and edit, or just use configs/v1/scope_default.json directly -- it has no institution-specific values, only the SLURM profile (cluster/profiles/*.yaml) does.
name: my_scope
_comment_overrides: time_limit_overrides is dataset-keyed (applies to every model, e.g. mlrod's huge row count); model_time_limit_overrides is model -> dataset -> seconds (applies only to that one model on that one dataset, e.g. EBM's wide-feature interaction-detection cost) -- see configs/v1/scope_default.json for real, evidence-based values and cluster/opportunistic_scheduler.py::effective_time_limit's docstring for why both exist.
